Set up a dedicated Google OAuth application
  1. Create a Google Cloud project for Wildsea Shrubbery and enable the Google Drive API.
  2. Configure its OAuth consent screen. While testing, add your Google account as a test user.
  3. Create an OAuth client of type Web application.
  4. Add to its authorized JavaScript origins.
  5. Paste the new client ID above. No client secret is needed.

Open Google Cloud credentials ↗

Only files created or opened with this app are accessible. Access tokens stay in memory and disappear when you close or reload the page. Saving to Drive is explicit.
A SMALL SET OF GOOD TOOLS

Writing in Shrubbery

Use headings, bold, italics, lists and Markdown tables as you would in Deltagreenery. The preview uses the supplied Wildsea fonts and artwork.

Editor tabs

Text edits your Markdown. Style edits CSS scoped to the preview, using selectors such as .sheet h1 or .sheet .box. Snippets stores reusable blocks: start each with \snippet Name and select its button to insert it at your text cursor. Properties edits document information and page defaults. All four views save together in your browser, Markdown exports, and Drive files.

Insertion menus

Tables contains striped, plain, ruled, compact, roll and enclosed tables, plus labelled fields. Columns offers equal columns and wide/narrow layouts. Blocks holds boxes, notes, tracks and lists. Templates inserts a ready-to-edit set of pages after the page containing your cursor, keeping existing content. An empty current page is filled instead.

Templates follow the supplied PDFs: Reach (10 pages), Character element (2), Character aspects (1), Hazard (2), Scenario (14), and Quickplay (2). Quickplay uses landscape Letter: {{page size=letter}}. Other pages use size=wildsea by default. Inserted templates start with header=true and accent=red. Change the section accent in Page style or edit the first page directive.

Pages and columns

\page

{{columns,three
First column
\column
Second column
\column
Third column
}}

Layouts: two, three, two-one and one-two. Nest a two-column block in the wide column to make the page 18 layout. Put full-width text above or below the block.

Boxes and subtitles

{{box,black,accent=mustard
### Radio {{accent (d66 Broadcast Table)}}
Your text, fields, or table.
}}

With {{box, the border and accents inherit the page colour. Black is the default. An explicit first colour overrides the border; accent= overrides subtitles, tracks and pale row shading. {{note is also accepted as a box.

Striped fields

{{fields
**Essentials:** A memorable introduction.
**Specialties:** What they can do.
**Attitude:** How they treat the crew.
}}

Each source line is one entry. Long entries wrap and keep their background. Standard Markdown tables also receive alternating shading.

Tracks and trackbreaks

Write {{track 3|2|5}} to draw ten circles, with separators after the third and fifth circles. Each number is the length of a group. Use {{track 6}} for six circles without breaks, or choose Blocks → Track with breaks. Tracks can sit beside a label or inside a box or field. Use positive whole numbers, up to 60 circles total.

Section accents

Select an accent in Page style with Current section selected to color the reach from its header onwards. Covers start sections automatically. For a section without a cover, use {{page header=true accent=willow}}. The first page also starts a section. Ordinary Markdown headings do not reset colors. A new header without an accent returns to the document default (black unless changed).

Palette and backgrounds

Colours: willow, olive, malachite, blue, mustard, raspberry, red, ember, lagoon, indigo, plum, umber, burgundy, antique-gold, midnight, dark-green, black. Backgrounds: canopy, reach, plain.

{{page background=reach accent=mustard}}

Saving and printing

Your draft saves in this browser as you type. Use My documents to download or import Markdown. Google Drive uses its own connection and explicit save button. Ctrl/Cmd+S saves locally; Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+S saves to Drive when connected.

Standard pages are 10 × 8.5 inches; Quickplay pages are 11 × 8.5 inches. Overflow warnings mean you should shorten the page or add \page. Print at 100% with browser headers and footers off and background graphics on. The preview's zoom and spread mode do not change the PDF.

The Style tab supports document CSS. Arbitrary HTML and InDesign-style positioning are not supported. Wildsea belongs to Quillhound Studios and Felix Isaacs. This is an independent local writing tool. The editable guide demonstrates the supported layouts.
